dashboard.title: Corrective action plan
dashboard.description: Remarks and corrective actions across all sources: status, ageing, departments and budget-dependent actions.

sources.title: Sources of remarks
sources.description: Workshops, audits, assessments, complaints, KPIs, risks, benchmarking studies — every remark starts from a source.
sources.newHint: Record where the remarks come from; add the remarks on the source page.
sources.noRemarks: No remarks on this source yet.

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.description: Every remark with its owner, due date and corrective actions — filtered to what you may see.

remark.addHint: The due date follows the priority (working time, configurable); the owner defaults to the section manager.
remark.priorityHint: Critical 30 · High 60 · Medium 90 · Low 180 days by default.
remark.ownerHint: Empty: the manager of the section (or department).
remark.reassignHint: The new owner is notified and the previous one loses the owner role.
remark.rejectHintFinal: Rejection is final. Explain why the remark does not apply.
remark.rejectHintPmo: The PM Office confirms the rejection or sends the remark back.
remark.sendBackHint: The owner must accept the remark and plan actions.
remark.submitHint: Each draft or returned action goes to the PM Office for validation.
remark.verifyHint: Did the corrective actions remove the cause? Not effective reopens the remark.

pmoDecision.sent-back: Sent back by the PM Office

rootCause.title: Root cause analysis
rootCause.hint: Use 5 Whys, a fishbone or a short text. The configurable rule decides when it is required before actions are submitted.

actions.title: Corrective actions
actions.empty: No actions yet. Add a new action or link an existing one.
actions.linkHint: One action can address several remarks; its progress then counts for each of them.
actions.listDescription: Update your actions monthly; the PM Office validates new actions and approves completions and extensions.

budget.title: Budget
budget.routingHint: When the PM Office approves this action, a draft program request (source "Action Plan") is created in Portfolio and linked back.
budget.routingOnApprove: Approving creates a draft program request (source "Action Plan") linked to this action.

validation.title: Validate action {{number}}
validation.projectHint: Optional: the action's progress can mirror the project's progress (setting).
validation.pendingTitle: This action is waiting for your validation.

progress.hint: Record the achievement percentage with a short note; 100 % needs evidence before completion is requested.

evidence.hint: Upload the evidence of implementation; it is required before completion is requested.

completion.hint: The PM Office reviews the evidence and approves the completion.
completion.noEvidence: Upload evidence on the Evidence tab first.

extension.title: Extension requests
extension.hint: Current end date: {{date}}. The PM Office approves the new date.

quality.after-remark-due: Ends after the remark is due

suggestions.title: Suggested remarks
suggestions.description: KPI targets missed, risk events and ineffective controls suggest remarks. Raise one in a click (the record is linked) or dismiss it with a reason.
suggestions.raiseHint: A remark is created on the system source with a live link to the record.

settings.title: Corrective action plan
settings.description: Due dates, responses, root cause rule, monitoring and the integrations that raise remarks.
settings.countWorkingDaysHint: On: due dates skip weekends and holidays (business hours of the unit).
settings.rejectionNeedsPmoConfirmationHint: Off (default): the owner's rejection is final.
settings.rootCauseRuleHint: Expression with priority, type, sourceType, criterion. Empty: never required.
settings.escalatePmoWorkingDays: Escalate late actions to the PMO after (working days)

ai.extractHint: Paste the report or minutes; the AI drafts remarks you review one by one.
ai.suggestHint: Drafts of corrective actions and similar existing actions you could link instead.

currentStatus.waitingAccept: Waiting for the owner to accept or reject the remark (due {{date}}).
currentStatus.sentBack: The PM Office sent the rejection back: accept the remark and plan actions (due {{date}}).
currentStatus.waitingPmoConfirm: The owner rejected the remark; waiting for the PM Office to confirm.
currentStatus.waitingActions: Plan the corrective actions and submit them for validation (due {{date}}).
currentStatus.rootCauseRequired: Analyse the root cause, then plan and submit the actions (due {{date}}).
currentStatus.correct: Actions returned for correction: update and resubmit them.
currentStatus.actionsRejected: All actions were rejected: plan new actions.
currentStatus.waitingPmo: Waiting for the PM Office to validate the actions.
currentStatus.actionsApproved: Actions approved: implementation can start ({{done}} of {{total}} completed).
currentStatus.inProgress: Implementation in progress: {{done}} of {{total}} actions completed.
currentStatus.waitingVerification: All actions completed; waiting for the effectiveness check.
currentStatus.waitingValidation: Waiting for the PM Office to validate the action.
currentStatus.waitingCompletion: Waiting for the PM Office to approve the completion.
currentStatus.waitingExtension: Waiting for the PM Office to approve the extension.
currentStatus.actionReturned: The PM Office returned the action: correct it and resubmit with the remark.
currentStatus.actionRejected: The PM Office rejected the action.
currentStatus.actionDraft: Draft: submit it for validation from the remark.
currentStatus.actionLate: The action is late (end date {{date}}): update the achievement or request an extension.
currentStatus.actionInProgress: Update the achievement every month (end date {{date}}).
currentStatus.actionReadyForCompletion: Achievement at 100 %: upload evidence and request completion approval.

errors.actionNotLinkable: This action cannot be linked to the remark.
errors.dateInFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errors.endOnlyAtCompletion: The actual end date is set only at 100 %.
errors.extensionNotLater: The new end date must be later than the current one.
errors.invalidTransition: This step is not possible in the current status.
errors.noActionsToSubmit: There is no draft or returned action to submit.
errors.notEditable: This record can no longer be edited.
errors.reassignOutsideUnit: The new owner must belong to the remark's unit.
errors.rootCauseRequired: Analyse the root cause before submitting the actions.
